{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 36 jumbo [[Cookbook:Shrimp|shrimp]], peeled and deveined
* Kosher [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallot]], finely minced
* 2 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemons]], juiced
* Splash of [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]]

== Procedure ==
#Season shrimp liberally with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper. Set aside.
#Melt 2 tbsp butter with olive oil in a large [[Cookbook:Sauté Pan|sauté pan]] over medium high heat. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until garlic is golden.
#Add shrimp and cook, [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|tossing]] occasionally, until shrimp turns pink and opaque. Keep warm.
#In a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], melt 2 tbsp butter over medium heat. Add shallot and cook for 30 seconds.
#Add lemon juice, heavy cream, and remaining butter. Cook until heated through and butter has melted. Check for taste and adjust seasoning if desired.
#Spoon sauce over shrimp and serve warm.
